headline: Ghana Ministry to Pay Judicial Staff Salary Arrears in Two Instalments
summary: The Ministry of Finance in Ghana approved the payment of reviewed salary arrears to Judicial Service Staff Association members and the lower court bench in two instalments starting in November 2026.
why: Public sector wage disbursements affect government fiscal expenditures and local consumer liquidity.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Staged public salary payments impact government fiscal outlays.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
